title: Give Up the Queen
setup: Black's king is still on e8, boxed in by its own bishop and pawns, with a knight on d7 blocking your rook's road to d8.
hint: One black piece is stopping your rook from mating on d8. What would make it leave that square?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on d1 already wants d8, only the knight on d7 stands in its road, and your bishop on g5 already covers d8 and e7. {{Qb8+}} costs a whole queen and forces {{Nxb8}}, the one legal reply — and the knight is now on the wrong square. {{Rd8#}} finishes.
